# basedraft

> basedraft sells finished websites (templates) in Next.js and Astro, shows every section in them as a block, lets you rearrange and rewrite a template in Studio, and gives away basedraft UI, its own library of React components, as the npm package @basedraft/ui.

Everything here is React 19 and Tailwind CSS 4, typed with TypeScript.

## basedraft UI (free)

basedraft UI is an npm package of React components, each one designed in basedraft's own style:

```
npm install @basedraft/ui motion @phosphor-icons/react
```

Import its stylesheet once, in the root layout: `import "@basedraft/ui/styles.css";`. No Tailwind setup is needed: it carries the theme in light and dark, and a .dark class or data-theme="dark" on any element above the components switches them. A project already on Tailwind v4 can import `@basedraft/ui/theme.css` in its global stylesheet instead and add `@source "../node_modules/@basedraft/ui/dist";`. Every component works in Next.js server pages as it is. Getting started: https://basedraft.site/components/get-started

### Actions

- [Button](https://basedraft.site/components/button): A pill in ink, metal, paper, glass, outline or ghost, with a field of dithered dots while it loads. `import { Button } from "@basedraft/ui"`
- [Hold button](https://basedraft.site/components/hold-button): Press and hold to confirm: ink fills it as you hold, and letting go early cancels. `import { HoldButton } from "@basedraft/ui"`
- [Copy button](https://basedraft.site/components/copy-button): Copies a piece of text, its icon turning over into a check as a ring spreads from it. `import { CopyButton } from "@basedraft/ui"`
- [Command line](https://basedraft.site/components/command-line): A shell command on a small ink terminal, colored, with a copy button and a switch between package managers. `import { CommandLine } from "@basedraft/ui"`
- [Split button](https://basedraft.site/components/split-button): One action and its alternatives, the way a merge button works: pick another from the caret and it takes the pill's place, its name rolling in, ready for the next press. `import { SplitButton } from "@basedraft/ui"`
- [Toolbar](https://basedraft.site/components/toolbar): Tools on one white bar, with toggles, a group whose chip slides, a tooltip that glides from tool to tool, and a More menu when it runs out of room. `import { Toolbar, ToolbarButton, ToolbarToggle, ToolbarGroup, ToolbarSeparator } from "@basedraft/ui"`
- [Action bar](https://basedraft.site/components/action-bar): An ink bar that rises while things are selected, its count rolling, with what you can do to all of them and a way to let them go. `import { ActionBar, ActionBarButton } from "@basedraft/ui"`
- [Theme toggle](https://basedraft.site/components/theme-toggle): Light and dark, switched with a circle of the new theme opening from the button, a sun that turns into a moon, and a System choice. `import { ThemeToggle, ThemeSwitcher } from "@basedraft/ui"`

### Forms

- [Input](https://basedraft.site/components/input): A text field pressed into the page that lifts to a white face as you type, with room for an icon or a suffix. `import { Input } from "@basedraft/ui"`
- [Textarea](https://basedraft.site/components/textarea): A longer field that grows as you type, with a small ring that counts toward its limit. `import { Textarea } from "@basedraft/ui"`
- [Switch](https://basedraft.site/components/switch): A recessed track that fills with ink, and a bead for a knob that stretches while you press it. `import { Switch } from "@basedraft/ui"`
- [Segmented control](https://basedraft.site/components/segmented): One choice of a few in a machined track, the chosen one on a raised thumb that slides. `import { Segmented } from "@basedraft/ui"`
- [Slider](https://basedraft.site/components/slider): A value along an ink track: a bead to drag, a bubble that says the value, and marked stops under it. `import { Slider } from "@basedraft/ui"`
- [Checkbox](https://basedraft.site/components/checkbox): A box pressed into the page that fills with ink as its tick draws in, with a half-on state and a row that carries a label and a line. `import { Checkbox, CheckboxRow } from "@basedraft/ui"`
- [Radio group](https://basedraft.site/components/radio-group): One choice from a short list, as rows with an ink dot and a bead, or as cards that take an ink edge. `import { RadioGroup, RadioGroupItem } from "@basedraft/ui"`
- [Select](https://basedraft.site/components/select): A pill that opens a card of choices in groups, ticked in ink, moved by the arrow keys and by typing a name. `import { Select } from "@basedraft/ui"`
- [Code input](https://basedraft.site/components/code-input): A one-time code a cell at a time: typing moves along, a paste or a phone's autofill fills them all, and a wrong code shakes. `import { CodeInput } from "@basedraft/ui"`
- [Field](https://basedraft.site/components/field): A label, a hint and an error around any control, wired for screen readers, with a count when there's a limit. `import { Field } from "@basedraft/ui"`
- [Password field](https://basedraft.site/components/password-field): A password that helps as you type: an eye to show it, a four-step meter with a word for how strong, rules that tick as they're met, and a word when Caps Lock is on. `import { PasswordField } from "@basedraft/ui"`
- [Chips](https://basedraft.site/components/chips): Filters as a row of chips that fill with ink as a check springs in, with counts, several or one at a time, a long tail folded into +N, and Clear once anything is on. `import { Chips } from "@basedraft/ui"`
- [Combobox](https://basedraft.site/components/combobox): A select you can type into: results filter and group as you go, the match drawn in bold, with chips for several and a row to create what's missing. `import { Combobox } from "@basedraft/ui"`
- [Inline edit](https://basedraft.site/components/inline-edit): Text that becomes a field where it stands, the same size and type, growing as you type, with saving, a check, and a shake when it is refused. `import { InlineEdit } from "@basedraft/ui"`
- [Tag input](https://basedraft.site/components/tag-input): A field that turns what you type into chips on Enter or a comma, splits a pasted list, and lets each chip be checked, edited in place or taken away. `import { TagInput } from "@basedraft/ui"`
- [Number field](https://basedraft.site/components/number-field): A pill with − and + that speed up as they're held, a label you drag sideways to scrub, and arrow keys with Shift for bigger steps. `import { NumberField } from "@basedraft/ui"`
- [Date picker](https://basedraft.site/components/date-picker): A field that opens a month whose pages slide the way you go, walked by the arrow keys, for one day or a range with a band that follows the pointer. `import { Calendar, DatePicker } from "@basedraft/ui"`
- [File drop](https://basedraft.site/components/file-drop): A zone that wakes when files are dragged over the page and lifts to meet them, listing each with its kind, its progress, and why it failed or was turned away. `import { FileDrop } from "@basedraft/ui"`

### Overlays

- [Dialog](https://basedraft.site/components/dialog): A white card lifted over a dimmed page, the hero's light at its head, that holds focus until its question is answered. `import { Dialog, DialogTrigger, DialogContent, DialogIcon, DialogTitle, DialogDescription, DialogFooter, DialogClose } from "@basedraft/ui"`
- [Sheet](https://basedraft.site/components/sheet): A panel that floats in from an edge with the page still in view, and from the bottom, a phone's sheet with a grip to drag it away. `import { Sheet, SheetTrigger, SheetContent, SheetHeader, SheetTitle, SheetDescription, SheetBody, SheetFooter, SheetClose } from "@basedraft/ui"`
- [Popover](https://basedraft.site/components/popover): A small card that opens from its button for one setting or a link to share, follows it as the page scrolls, and flips when there's no room. `import { Popover, PopoverTrigger, PopoverContent, PopoverClose } from "@basedraft/ui"`
- [Menu](https://basedraft.site/components/menu): A dropdown of actions in quiet sections, each with its shortcut on small keys, options that tick, and the destructive one set apart in red. `import { Menu, MenuTrigger, MenuContent, MenuLabel, MenuSeparator, MenuGroup, MenuItem, MenuCheckboxItem } from "@basedraft/ui"`
- [Command](https://basedraft.site/components/command): A search that does things: type to narrow pages and actions, arrows and Enter to go, in place or as a ⌘K palette with the hero's light at its head. `import { Command, CommandInput, CommandList, CommandEmpty, CommandGroup, CommandItem, CommandFooter, CommandDialog } from "@basedraft/ui"`
- [Toast](https://basedraft.site/components/toast): Short ink notes that rise at the corner and leave on their own, stack like paper, spread when you point at them, and update in place. `import { toast, Toaster } from "@basedraft/ui"`
- [Hover card](https://basedraft.site/components/hover-card): A preview of where a link leads, opening after a pause, staying open on the way to it, with a caret pointing back at the link. `import { HoverCard, HoverCardTrigger, HoverCardContent } from "@basedraft/ui"`

### Navigation

- [Tabs](https://basedraft.site/components/tabs): A quiet row of names, the selected one inked on a pill that slides, its panel rising in. `import { Tabs, TabsList, TabsTrigger, TabsContent } from "@basedraft/ui"`
- [Accordion](https://basedraft.site/components/accordion): Numbered questions on one card, each answer springing open as its plus turns into a cross. `import { Accordion, AccordionItem, AccordionTrigger, AccordionContent } from "@basedraft/ui"`
- [Breadcrumb](https://basedraft.site/components/breadcrumb): The path to the page, with a pill that glides from crumb to crumb, a long middle folded into one menu, and a caret that jumps to a level's siblings. `import { Breadcrumb } from "@basedraft/ui"`
- [Pagination](https://basedraft.site/components/pagination): Pages of a long list, the current one inked on a pill that slides, a row that keeps its length as you go, and numbers that roll the way you went. `import { Pagination } from "@basedraft/ui"`
- [Table of contents](https://basedraft.site/components/table-of-contents): A long page's sections with an ink bar that slides to the one you're reading, the ones you've passed a shade darker, and links that glide there without a jump. `import { TableOfContents } from "@basedraft/ui"`

### Display

- [Badge](https://basedraft.site/components/badge): A small stamp in ink, gray, outline, paper or metal, with a status dot that can pulse. `import { Badge } from "@basedraft/ui"`
- [Card](https://basedraft.site/components/card): A raised face on a soft gray shell, the actions resting on the shell beneath it; it lifts under the pointer with a light that follows, and takes a cover. `import { Card, CardMedia, CardHeader, CardTitle, CardDescription, CardContent, CardFooter } from "@basedraft/ui"`
- [Avatar](https://basedraft.site/components/avatar): Initials on a stone tint drawn from the name, a status dot, and a group that fans out when you point at it. `import { Avatar, AvatarGroup } from "@basedraft/ui"`
- [Kbd](https://basedraft.site/components/kbd): A keycap that goes down when you press its key on your keyboard. `import { Kbd, KbdGroup } from "@basedraft/ui"`
- [Tooltip](https://basedraft.site/components/tooltip): An ink bubble with a caret, carrying the action's shortcut on small caps. `import { Tooltip } from "@basedraft/ui"`
- [Number](https://basedraft.site/components/number): A number that rolls to its value a digit at a time, as currency, compact, percent or plain. `import { RollingNumber } from "@basedraft/ui"`
- [Marquee](https://basedraft.site/components/marquee): An endless row of logos or quotes that drifts sideways, fades at its edges and holds still when pointed at. `import { Marquee } from "@basedraft/ui"`
- [Steps](https://basedraft.site/components/stepper): The way through a task in a few steps, down the page or across, with a line that fills as you go. `import { Steps, Step } from "@basedraft/ui"`
- [Empty state](https://basedraft.site/components/empty-state): What a list says before it has anything: a small fan of ghost cards that spreads when pointed at, a title, a line and the action that starts it. `import { EmptyState } from "@basedraft/ui"`
- [Timeline](https://basedraft.site/components/timeline): An activity log: times in a gutter, one rail through raised beads for what matters and small rings for the rest, days gathered, comments in bubbles, new events sliding in on top. `import { Timeline, TimelineGroup, TimelineItem, TimelineQuote, TimelineMeta } from "@basedraft/ui"`
- [Compare slider](https://basedraft.site/components/compare-slider): Two versions of one thing split by a line you drag: press anywhere and it springs there, arrow keys step it, and each side's name steps aside as the line comes near. `import { CompareSlider } from "@basedraft/ui"`
- [Code block](https://basedraft.site/components/code-block): Code on a card with its file's name or tabs for each package manager, colored in the theme's own hues, long lines wrapping on a hanging indent, marked lines, and a copy that turns to a check. `import { CodeBlock } from "@basedraft/ui"`
- [Resizable panels](https://basedraft.site/components/resizable): Two panels and a line between them that catches at sizes you come back to, folds a side away, and springs home on a double-click. `import { ResizablePanel, Resizable } from "@basedraft/ui"`
- [Carousel](https://basedraft.site/components/carousel): Slides of any width that you drag or flick and that carry on with your speed before settling, with dots or a bar, and that wait while no one's looking. `import { CarouselSlide, Carousel } from "@basedraft/ui"`

### Data

- [Stat](https://basedraft.site/components/stat): A number that rolls into place, its change marked up or down in the tone that means good or bad, over a line that draws in and reads out each point you point at. `import { Stat } from "@basedraft/ui"`
- [Gauge](https://basedraft.site/components/gauge): A reading against its limit as a dial of dots, filling in ink or in the tone of its zone, its edge dithered and springing to the value as the number counts along. `import { Gauge } from "@basedraft/ui"`
- [Bar list](https://basedraft.site/components/bar-list): The top few of something, ranked, each over a slim bar whose dots thin through an ordered dither to a hard edge at its value, growing in one by one and gliding when the ranking changes. `import { BarList } from "@basedraft/ui"`
- [Sparkline](https://basedraft.site/components/sparkline): A trend in the space of a word: a smooth line that draws in, a wash under it that fades or thins as dots, and a dot on the latest value that can pulse while it's live. `import { Sparkline } from "@basedraft/ui"`

### Patterns



### Feedback

- [Meter](https://basedraft.site/components/meter): Progress drawn in dots, its edge dissolving through an ordered dither and springing as it moves. `import { Meter } from "@basedraft/ui"`
- [Alert](https://basedraft.site/components/alert): A note in the flow of the page in four tones, washed with its tone or bleeding in from the edge through a dither, with actions, that folds away when closed. `import { Alert } from "@basedraft/ui"`
- [Spinner](https://basedraft.site/components/spinner): A ring of dots with a crest that sweeps around it, its tail dissolving through an ordered dither. `import { Spinner } from "@basedraft/ui"`
- [Skeleton](https://basedraft.site/components/skeleton): Solid gray blocks, lines and circles in the shape of what's loading, with a band of fine dots passing through. `import { Skeleton, SkeletonText, SkeletonAvatar } from "@basedraft/ui"`

## basedraft Pro components

Composed, dashboard-grade pieces that come with basedraft Pro. Anyone can try them live on their pages; their source is for Pro accounts, copied or downloaded from the page once signed in, and they read the same theme as the package.

- [Tour](https://basedraft.site/components/tour) (Pro): A walk through a screen one thing at a time: the page dims, a window opens over the thing and glides to the next taking its shape, with a card that goes to the side with room.
- [Tree](https://basedraft.site/components/tree) (Pro): Folders that spring open beside a guide line, darker along the branch to the chosen row, which rides a pill that glides; run by the keyboard like a file tree.
- [Navigation menu](https://basedraft.site/components/navigation-menu) (Pro): A site's top navigation with one panel that travels between its menus, gliding across and resizing to each one's content as it slides in the way you went, with a caret that follows.
- [Dither image](https://basedraft.site/components/dither-image) (Pro): Any picture printed as an ordered dither, in ink, as round halftone dots or in its own colors stepped down, that develops into view and shows the photo through a dissolve.
- [Sortable list](https://basedraft.site/components/sortable-list) (Pro): Rows you lift and carry with a spring while the rest make room, scrolling at the edges, and reorder from the keyboard just the same.
- [Data table](https://basedraft.site/components/data-table) (Pro): Rows on a white sheet that sort with a turning arrow and glide into place, pick in ranges with Shift, open for detail, and keep their header and first column in view.
- [Area chart](https://basedraft.site/components/area-chart) (Pro): Smooth lines over a soft wash that draw in from the left, with a crosshair that snaps to the nearest point, stacking, and a legend that re-scales on a spring.
- [Bar chart](https://basedraft.site/components/bar-chart) (Pro): Grouped or stacked bars, standing up or lying down, that grow in one after another, with a band that follows the pointer, values below zero and labels on the bars.
- [Donut chart](https://basedraft.site/components/donut-chart) (Pro): Parts of a whole that sweep around a ring, slide out to show their share in the middle, and a total that rolls up as it fills.
- [Heatmap](https://basedraft.site/components/heatmap) (Pro): A year of activity a day at a time, each day's cell shaded by an ordered dither instead of a fade, fitting as many weeks as it has room for, with a card for any day by pointer or keys.
- [Uptime](https://basedraft.site/components/uptime) (Pro): A service's days as slim bars, a bad day mixed amber or red through an ordered dither in proportion to how much went wrong, with its incidents a point away.
- [Funnel](https://basedraft.site/components/funnel) (Pro): How many make it from step to step: bars that rise in turn, the ones lost dissolving above each through a dither or held as a faint wash, a band carrying the flow, and what each step kept.
- [Kanban board](https://basedraft.site/components/kanban-board) (Pro): Columns of cards you carry by hand or by keyboard: the lifted card tilts and casts a deeper shadow, the others make room, and every move is announced.
- [AI chat](https://basedraft.site/components/ai-chat) (Pro): An assistant thread: replies that stream in word by word, tool calls that open to show their work, and a composer that sends, attaches and stops.
- [Inbox](https://basedraft.site/components/inbox) (Pro): A notification center behind a bell: an unread count that rolls, tabs on a sliding pill, items grouped by day that you mark read with a click or a swipe.
- [Pricing table](https://basedraft.site/components/pricing-table) (Pro): A whole pricing section: a monthly and yearly switch whose prices roll, Yearly tagged with what it saves, the plan you'd pick lit by the hero's light, seats with a rolling total, and a comparison that keeps the plan names in view.
- [App sidebar](https://basedraft.site/components/app-sidebar) (Pro): An app's navigation down the left: a workspace switcher, search, sections with counts and groups, a pill that slides to the page you're on, a rail of icons, and a drawer that swipes away on a phone.
- [Onboarding checklist](https://basedraft.site/components/onboarding) (Pro): A new account's first steps in a card that keeps count: a ring that fills, ticks that draw in, the next step opening on its own, a pill to fold it into, and a finish that blooms.
- [Wizard](https://basedraft.site/components/wizard) (Pro): A form in steps: a rail that fills, each step sliding in from the side you're heading, checks that land the cursor on what's wrong, a review to read it all back, and a finish.

## For AI coding agents

To add a basedraft component: install @basedraft/ui if the project doesn't have it, import its styles once in the root layout, then import the component by name from "@basedraft/ui". Each component's page lists its parts, every prop, examples, its keyboard behavior and accessibility notes. Prefer these over writing the same component by hand. To own the code instead, each component is also one self-contained file at https://basedraft.site/ui/<name>.tsx, reading the theme at https://basedraft.site/ui/basedraft.css.

## Templates (paid)

Whole sites, every page included, in Next.js 16 or Astro 7. $79 each, or all of them with Pro ($149 once). Bought templates download as a zip from https://basedraft.site/purchases or go straight to a new GitHub repository; unzip, then `npm install && npm run dev`.

- [Zuno](https://basedraft.site/templates/zuno): Fintech. An AI investing app, on a pure black page with dithered lime. 25 pages, $79.
- [Noma](https://basedraft.site/templates/noma): AI and data. An AI layer for Postgres, drawn like a printed engraving. 12 pages, $79.
- [Auren](https://basedraft.site/templates/auren): Developer tools. A native code editor with an agent, in ink, paper and amber. 11 pages, $79.

## Blocks

Every section of every template, live at any width, with its code (Pro): https://basedraft.site/blocks

## Studio

Open a template in Studio (https://basedraft.site/studio), free, to rearrange its sections and rewrite its words on the real site, then copy it into Figma or take the code: https://basedraft.site/studio

## Pro

Every template, block and export, and every future update, for one payment: https://basedraft.site/pro
